note: 70/20/10 iteration. 70% close to the clean editorial Offsuit anchor, 20% adjacent, 10% wild. Prune objectively-bad or too-similar. User favorite so far: monochrome-editorial (not yet sold). Keep 10-20 candidates max.
convergence-note: Rounds 4-5 regenerated the same 4 archetypes (accent-restraint, ledger, spread, instrument) — the near/adjacent space around the editorial anchor is saturated. Curating strictly (supersede, don't grow). A future round should push the WILD lane harder or await user signal, not add more near-editorial variants.

candidates.thesis: Printed strategy broadsheet in the dark: ink-on-paper typography, hairline rules, two inks + one jade signal, serif figures; card as fine-press object; table as typeset data page, no felt.
Private-bank OLED black; depth by luminance + hairline, one champagne glow for the player to act, ivory cards, weighted critically-damped motion.
Premium LIGHT theme: bone canvas, one oxblood accent, museum whitespace; cards the only framed objects; seating drawn in space.
Near-black instrument where motion is the identity; villains a monogram + stack + card-backs on the void; table implied by a shared elliptical baseline, never drawn.
Wild: a spatial nocturne instrument, most distinct of the set — different concept, still premium/minimal, no felt.
The table re-architected as a typeset standings ledger with true column rules — seats, stacks and pot as a set financial table. Supersedes the r2 ledger take.
Anchor refined purely on the TYPE program: high-contrast display serif for figures, reading serif for headings, a size-aware tracking ramp. A re-cut of the same publication.
Editorial DNA in an asymmetric magazine-spread layout — column-broken rather than centered.
The editorial temperature shifted cooler — a graphite/paper cousin of the warm bone anchor, one step away.
A graphite trading-desk instrument — poker as a precise quant terminal, still premium/minimal, no felt.
The product shell elevated: a spade monogram masthead, hairline brand divider, uppercase nav with an active-tab underline that draws in along the rule. A real premium product frame.
The same broadsheet held to a strict documented 8px baseline — the 12px step banished from vertical rhythm so masthead, lists and table lock to one grid. Spacing as the upgrade.
Motion layer taken to reference tier: structural hairlines draw in from centre on a spring, the page composes itself, serif figures settle. All 140-320ms, reduced-motion-safe.
The one accent rationed hard — spent on the single most decision-critical truth per screen and nowhere else. Supersedes the earlier rare-ink take (same axis, higher execution).
A Braun/trading-desk instrument with a 270° SVG equity dial — poker as a precise machined gauge, one live needle. Supersedes the r4 precision-gauge take.
